'''Currsk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], along with his brother, [[Keerag]]. After the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Deggar Feps]] angered the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Sonnos]], Feps attempted to travel from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], by gaining passage aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Lost Lady]]''. Currsk and Keerag also took up places on the ship, planning to find and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Feps.
